authorization.branch_text: Retire only the demonstrated inadequate frozen final-mean/readout interfaces, not semantic information in all encoder states. Use component oracle/linear ceilings to preregister one targeted representation change on fresh material: minimal final-layer task adaptation if semantic match/polarity is limiting, or explicit caller-supplied ordinal rubric grounding if grade identifiability is limiting.
rubric_grounding_retirement_basis: Rubric-anchor S0 mechanical screen failed: 20 of 60 anchors failed the stage-marker screen.

Rubric-anchor two-reviewer opaque gate failed: 7 jointly ambiguous anchors across durability, plausibility, priority, similarity, suitability, urgency; two reviewers independently read one durability ladder as inverted; gate requires both reviewers accept all 60 anchors with zero ambiguous and zero rejected.
Rubric grounding is therefore retired for this assay. The retirement is on authored-scale and audit evidence, not on model outcomes.
The remaining authorized branch is minimal final-layer encoder task adaptation, preregistered here.
authorization.branch_budget_note: After this branch, both remaining authorized branches under the parent decision tree (explicit rubric grounding and minimal final-layer encoder adaptation) are exhausted for this assay.

design_under_test.one_sentence: Unfreeze exactly the final transformer layer of the pinned encoder and add one scalar-per-parameter diagonal adapter on that layer only, keep the frozen rank-64 PageReader value/relevance/direction/knownness equations byte-identical, and fit the unchanged frozen recipe with a lower learning rate on encoder parameters than on reader parameters.
design_under_test.single_change: The final transformer layer of the encoder plus a diagonal adapter on that layer. The encoder embedding and layers 1 through 11 stay bit-identical. All reader equations and their rank-64 projections stay byte-identical.
design_under_test.new_arm: pages_adapted_final_layer: the frozen PageReader equations reading page features produced by an encoder whose final layer and final-layer diagonal adapter are trainable.
design_under_test.rationale_to_test: Corrected ECA-2 final pages atomic family macro is 0.085547 and the corrected conditional readout improved development atomic choice macro from 0.058594 to 0.205078 with 95 percent CIs excluding zero, yet failed every parent gate. The finite linear page-feature extent ceiling failed on held-out development unique texts (family macro MAE 0.38322989 over 240 unique development page texts, rank 180 of 384, train MSE 1.82e-29). The tested frozen final-mean linear interface does not carry extent identifiability. The only untested lever left by the parent decision tree is a small change to what the final layer represents.
design_under_test.why_this_scope: The linear ceiling bounds only the tested frozen final-mean linear function class. It does not prove semantic information is absent from all encoder states. Minimal final-layer adaptation changes the representation while leaving the corpus, the reader equations, the exact compiler, the calibration grids and every other frozen constant unchanged.

unchanged_paths.relevance: z_j = Wp h_page_j; relevance_j = z_j dot (Wqa h_q) / sqrt(64); rank 64; bias-free; unchanged
unchanged_paths.direction: direction_j = tanh(z_j dot (Wqd h_q) / sqrt(64)); rank 64; bias-free; unchanged
unchanged_paths.value: value_j = sigmoid(wv dot h_page_j + bv); unchanged
unchanged_paths.knownness: known = sigmoid(bk + softplus(uk) max_j relevance_j - softplus(vk) sum_j a_j (value_j - sum_l a_l value_l)^2); scalars unchanged
unchanged_paths.attention: softmax over relevance with the frozen page mask and frozen uniform-attention policy; unchanged
unchanged_paths.pooling: FP32 final-layer masked mean over non-padding tokens; width 384; native pooler and classifier unused; unchanged

trainable_surface.selection_rule: After the pinned encoder is loaded, set requires_grad_(False) on every encoder parameter, then set requires_grad_(True) on exactly two sets. Set A is every named parameter whose name starts with 'deberta.encoder.layer.11.'. Set B is one diagonal adapter scalar per element of every parameter in set A whose safetensors shape has rank at least 2, in ascending lexicographic name order. No other parameter anywhere in the process receives requires_grad=True. The reader parameters of the pages_adapted_final_layer arm are trainable under the unchanged frozen recipe as in the parent arm, and they are the only non-encoder trainable parameters.

unfrozen_encoder_parameters.layer_index_note: One-based layer 12 equals safetensors prefix 'deberta.encoder.layer.11.'. One-based layers 1 through 11 equal safetensors prefixes 'deberta.encoder.layer.0.' through 'deberta.encoder.layer.10.'.

diagonal_adapter.form: Multiplicative elementwise scale s initialized to exactly 1.0, applied as weight_effective = weight * s to each adapted weight matrix in the forward pass. The adapter is a separate tensor from the base weight, so base weight and adapter are both trainable and the adapter is not a reparameterization of full unfreezing in any other layer. At initialization the effective weights equal the frozen weights and the arm is identical to the frozen pages arm.
diagonal_adapter.targets: Exactly the six rank-at-least-2 weight matrices of set A: attention.self.query_proj.weight, attention.self.key_proj.weight, attention.self.value_proj.weight, attention.output.dense.weight, intermediate.dense.weight, output.dense.weight. Biases and LayerNorm gains are excluded because they are directly trainable through set A and an elementwise scale on a rank-1 tensor is redundant.
diagonal_adapter.initialization: all ones; the pre-fit adapted encoder must reproduce the frozen capture byte-identically (checked in screen C)

reader_parameters.components: wp 384x64 bias-free 24576; wqa 384x64 bias-free 24576; wqd 384x64 bias-free 24576; wv 384x1 plus bias 385; bk, uk, vk 3

trainable_parameter_fraction_bound.denominator_encoder_note: Loaded base AutoModel F32 parameter count recorded for this pinned NLI checkpoint (checkpoint F32 scalars 70831107 minus the unused classifier 1155 and pooler 147840). The launch receipt must reconcile the live named_parameters count against the metadata ledger before the bound is applied.
trainable_parameter_fraction_bound.enforcement: The launch receipt must record the exact trainable scalar count and both fractions before the first optimizer step, computed from the live parameter list. If either fraction exceeds its bound, the run fails closed before any fit. No parameter may be added after the bound is recorded.
trainable_parameter_fraction_bound.no_widening: No later amendment may raise these bounds. A failure at the bound retires the branch; it does not justify a larger trainable surface.

learning_rates.search_forbidden: A search over the encoder-to-reader learning-rate ratio is forbidden. The ratio is fixed in this preregistration. No grid, no schedule, no warmup, no per-layer multiplier and no dev-selected ratio is allowed.
learning_rates.optimizer: AdamW, weight_decay 0.0001, seed 7, 400 epochs, full cached training set accumulated in deterministic chunks, earliest minimum held-world validation objective. No development, calibration or final checkpoint selection.
learning_rates.other_recipe_unchanged: The frozen recipe is otherwise unchanged: the same four equal-weight loss components (relevance cross entropy onto the uniform relevant-page target, raw page-grade normalized MSE, orientation squared error on relevant pages, candidate known/unknown BCE), the same train-only per-coordinate mean/std normalizer with floor 0.01, the same K4 gradient protocol and the same frozen calibration grids.

mandatory_screens.fail_closed: Each screen fails closed. A failed screen stops the run, retains its artifacts and forbids weakening the screen or re-authoring inputs.

B_encoder_parameter_hash_check.scope: Every encoder parameter whose name does not start with 'deberta.encoder.layer.11.' must be byte-identical before and after the fit. This covers the embedding, layers 1 through 11 (safetensors layer.0 through layer.10), deberta.encoder.rel_embeddings, deberta.encoder.LayerNorm, and any loaded pooler parameter.
B_encoder_parameter_hash_check.procedure: At load, record the full encoder parameter hash and the non-final-layer subset hash over the sorted tuple of (name, dtype, shape, raw bytes) for every parameter. After the fit, recompute both. Require the non-final-layer subset hash to be identical, and require the changed set to equal exactly the layer-11 parameter names plus the adapter names.
B_encoder_parameter_hash_check.fail_reading: any change outside the final layer plus adapter fails closed. A single changed byte in any frozen parameter retires the run.
B_encoder_parameter_hash_check.kind: CPU hash comparison, zero forward, zero optimizer step

C_adapted_linear_ceiling.timing: CPU-only and must be run BEFORE any full GPU fit. The full GPU fit is the joint reader plus adaptation development fit on the whole train split.
C_adapted_linear_ceiling.adaptation_stage_note: The adapted final layer needs a trained state to produce adapted features. The bounded adaptation stage is the prerequisite for screen C: train the adaptation surface jointly with the reader under the frozen recipe, seed 7, on the unique supervised train page texts only, initialized from the pinned ECA-2 pages checkpoint. This is a bounded prerequisite, not the full development fit. The ordering requirement above is literal.
C_adapted_linear_ceiling.feature_source: Features produced by the adapted final layer (FP32 final-layer masked mean over non-padding tokens, width 384) on the unique supervised train page texts only.
C_adapted_linear_ceiling.fit_population: unique supervised train page texts only, exactly the same fit population as the retired page-only and augmented ceilings
C_adapted_linear_ceiling.procedure: bias-free FP64 least squares with numpy.linalg.lstsq(rcond=None), predicting raw extent; the same finite bias-free procedure, the same page normalization and the same solver policy as the measured page-only ceiling
C_adapted_linear_ceiling.required_diagnostics: rank, condition, train MSE, unidentified coefficient directions, normal-equation residual, independent second-solver agreement, and raw unclipped prediction range
C_adapted_linear_ceiling.evaluation: development unique-text family macro MAE over the same 240 unique development page texts used by the retired page-only ceiling
C_adapted_linear_ceiling.threshold_derivation: page-only development unique-text family macro MAE 0.3832298906765268 minus a predeclared absolute margin of 0.05
C_adapted_linear_ceiling.validation_prohibition: Report validation only as a reuse diagnostic. Passing or failing screen C on validation is prohibited.
C_adapted_linear_ceiling.identity_precondition: Before the adaptation stage, with the adapter at exactly 1.0 and the final layer at the pinned frozen weights, adapted features on the same texts must be byte-identical to the frozen capture; otherwise fail closed.
C_adapted_linear_ceiling.fail_reading: the adapted final layer does not carry held-out extent information the frozen final-mean space lacked by the predeclared margin; retire encoder adaptation for this assay; no full GPU fit is authorized
C_adapted_linear_ceiling.pass_reading: the adapted final-layer linear space carries held-out extent information the frozen space did not; a later development failure is then a negative result for this adaptation and optimization route
C_adapted_linear_ceiling.scope: finite pinned bias-free linear function class on the adapted representation; not a ranking bound and not proof that semantic information is absent
C_adapted_linear_ceiling.kind: CPU-only, FP64, zero optimizer steps during the screen itself

failure_branches.1_screen_C_fails_before_full_fit: Retire encoder adaptation for this assay. failure_branches.2_screen_A_or_B_fails: Fail closed before any fit. Retain the smoke or hash artifacts. Do not weaken the screen, do not re-author inputs and do not widen the trainable surface.
failure_branches.3_development_fails_any_absolute_gate: Record the negative evidence for this representation-change route. Do not widen capacity further, do not add layers, do not enlarge the adapter and do not raise the bound.
failure_branches.4_development_passes_absolute_gates_but_: The adaptation premise is falsified even though absolute metrics passed. Record the negative, do not promote and do not widen capacity.
failure_branches.5_development_passes_absolute_gates_and_: Require replication on seeds 7, 11 and 13 and a fresh independently audited final protocol before any promotion. No promotion in this protocol.
failure_branches.general: Every failure branch retains raw artifacts, per-decision rows and the exact failing screen. No failure branch authorizes re-authoring text, weakening a screen or selecting an epoch, seed, threshold or ratio from outcomes.
